title: Valid: a DEPLOYED claim guarantees ACTOR_REPORTED and also requires additional RUNTIME_OBSERVED evidence

acceptance_criteria.statement: N/A -- this fixture exists only to prove AS54-F005: CORE-017 sets a minimum evidence floor, not a maximum. A DEPLOYED claim requiring MORE evidence than the guaranteed ACTOR_REPORTED/CI_ATTESTED floor (here, unconditionally requiring RUNTIME_OBSERVED too) is never rejected merely for being stronger than that floor -- it still satisfies CORE-017 because ACTOR_REPORTED is unconditionally present in all_of.

claims.statement: This change was deployed, evidenced by the Builder's report AND additionally by direct runtime observation -- stronger than CORE-017's floor, not incompatible with it.

authority_disclaimer: This Task Contract describes already-authorized scope. It does not itself grant authority, tool access, credentials, remote-resource access, merge approval, deployment approval, or risk acceptance (CORE-001, CORE-002). Satisfying this contract's acceptance criteria and evidence requirements does not certify task success or accept the task; that judgment belongs to the Architect/Paulo review that consumes this contract's evidence, not to the contract or its validator.
